verdict.rationale: Whether a coding-agent CLI publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The pack contains no statement that ByteAsk's source is public or openly licensed. The only GitHub item is a separate Embedded-MCP repository, and nothing in the evidence gives a license for it either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
